headline: Your shuffle button needs a lawyer
meta_line: Example data: 48 tracks, 13 unique artists, 15 tracks from the top artist (31.25%).
observations: 15 of 48 tracks come from one artist (31.25%).
Only 13 unique artists show up across the whole playlist.
Most roastable pattern: one artist, many, many tracks.
roast: Fifteen tracks from the same artist? This is less a playlist and more an unpaid internship in the fan club. Your shuffle button is fighting for its life.
final_verdict: Your playlist has commitment issues with everyone except one artist.
